Minimum 3 independent searches per rate line per G7; label 'RESEARCH PENDING' if the floor is not met, never present a single data point as a firm benchmark.
If neither tier produces enough points to pass percentile_gate(min_points=5), suppress the band per G7/H9 rather than estimating it. State the minimum and what was actually achieved.
